create.title: Create Proposal
create.subtitle: Build a payment, ASA transfer, or rekey proposal and write it directly to the selected Algo Safe contract.
create.proposalTypeHint: Choose the transaction type the safe should execute once approved.
create.groupIdHint: Bootstrap creates group 1 by default; change this only if your safe uses another signer group.
create.rekeyWarning: Danger: executing this proposal permanently hands control of the safe address to the target address — the safe contract can no longer move any funds afterwards. Use it only to migrate to a newly deployed Algo Safe. It requires a signer group holding both the rekey action and group-admin privileges, at full threshold.
create.rekeyTargetHint: The address that takes over the safe account — usually a newly deployed safe's application address.
create.receiverHint: The address that will receive the ALGO payment or ASA transfer.
create.receiverOptInHint: Opt-in proposals always target the safe address itself.
create.rekeyAmountHint: A rekey is a zero-amount transaction carrying only the new auth address.
create.amountAlgoHint: The amount is converted to microAlgos before submission.
create.optedInAssetHint: Only assets already opted in by the safe are available here.
create.assetIdHintKnown: Choose a known asset for this network or enter any ASA ID manually.
create.assetIdHintManual: Enter the ASA ID the safe should opt in to.
create.expiryHint: Added to the current chain round to compute the proposal expiry round.
create.noteHint: Optional note stored with the proposal payload.
create.created: Proposal #{{proposalId}} was saved on-chain. Tx ID: {{txId}}
create.selfExecuteHint: Your signer group is 1-of-1, so your proposal is approved by itself — you can execute it in the same transaction.
create.selectAssetForBalance: Select an asset to see its available balance.
create.chooseKnownAsset: Choose a known asset ID or enter an ASA ID manually.

appCall.borrowedBody: Showing {{method}} as published by contract hash {{hash}} — this has NOT been confirmed to match the contract actually being called here.
appCall.notAbiBody: No 4-byte method selector is present in the first argument — nothing to verify against the ARC-56 registry.
appCall.lookupFailedTitle: Could not read this app from the network
appCall.registryUnreachableTitle: Could not reach the ARC-56 registry
appCall.registryUnreachableBody: Verification status is unknown due to a network error — this is not confirmation that the call is unverified. {{error}}
appCall.noSpecTitle: Not published in the ARC-56 registry
appCall.noSpecBody: This contract's exact bytecode (hash {{hash}}) has no published ARC-56 spec, and no other published contract declares a method with selector {{selector}}. Nothing about this call is verified — proceed with caution.
appCall.mismatchTitle: Method selector does not match this contract's spec
appCall.mismatchBody: This app's bytecode is verified (hash {{hash}}), but the method selector {{selector}} used in this call does not match any method in its published ARC-56 spec. Do not assume this call does what any description elsewhere claims it does.
appCall.verifiedBody: Matches the published ARC-56 spec for this exact contract bytecode (hash {{hash}}).
